paragraphs.source_en: The morning of the seventh day of the fifth month, in the twentieth year of Keichō.

units.source_en: The morning of the seventh day of the fifth month, in the twentieth year of Keichō.
units.source_zh: 庆长二十年五月初七，晨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长二十年五月初七，晨。

paragraphs.source_en: Before dawn, Matsudaira Tadanao marched through the night, passed the encampments of Mizuno Katsushige, Honda Tadamasa, and the others, and advanced to a position ahead of Hori Naoyori. The position lay between Tennōji and Isshinji, within sight of the enemy camp.

units.source_en: Before dawn, Matsudaira Tadanao marched through the night, passed the encampments of Mizuno Katsushige, Honda Tadamasa, and the others, and advanced to a position ahead of Hori Naoyori.
units.source_zh: 天还未亮，松平忠直连夜行军，穿过水野胜成和本多忠政等人的营地，一直来到堀直寄前方。

units.source_en: The position lay between Tennōji and Isshinji, within sight of the enemy camp.
units.source_zh: 此处位于天王寺和一心寺之间，可瞧见敌军阵营。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天还未亮，松平忠直连夜行军，穿过水野胜成和本多忠政等人的营地，一直来到堀直寄前方。此处位于天王寺和一心寺之间，可瞧见敌军阵营。

paragraphs.source_en: Shogun Tokugawa Hidetada, of course, had no intention of sitting in camp awaiting daybreak. He led his great army out of Senzuka in the Hour of the Ox, reached Wakae and Yao at first light, then carefully reconnoitred the surrounding ground, issued orders to every contingent, and made meticulous dispositions.

units.source_en: Shogun Tokugawa Hidetada, of course, had no intention of sitting in camp awaiting daybreak.
units.source_zh: 将军德川秀忠自不会在军营中坐等天亮。

units.source_en: He led his great army out of Senzuka in the Hour of the Ox, reached Wakae and Yao at first light, then carefully reconnoitred the surrounding ground, issued orders to every contingent, and made meticulous dispositions.
units.source_zh: 他率领大军于丑时从千冢出发，天刚蒙蒙亮便抵若江和八尾，并四处进行详细勘察，向各部传达命令，仔细部署。

paragraphs.source_zh: 将军德川秀忠自不会在军营中坐等天亮。他率领大军于丑时从千冢出发，天刚蒙蒙亮便抵若江和八尾，并四处进行详细勘察，向各部传达命令，仔细部署。

paragraphs.source_en: At that hour, Tokugawa Ieyasu was still fast asleep. Only after receiving Hidetada's report did he lead his army out of Hiraoka, cross the battlefields around Katayama and Dōmyōji, and reach Hirano, by which time it was nearly the Hour of the Snake.

units.source_en: At that hour, Tokugawa Ieyasu was still fast asleep.
units.source_zh: 此时，德川家康还在熟睡。

units.source_en: Only after receiving Hidetada's report did he lead his army out of Hiraoka, cross the battlefields around Katayama and Dōmyōji, and reach Hirano, by which time it was nearly the Hour of the Snake.
units.source_zh: 接到秀忠的通报之后，他方率军从枚冈出发，穿过片山、道明寺一带的战场，抵达平野，已近巳时。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，德川家康还在熟睡。接到秀忠的通报之后，他方率军从枚冈出发，穿过片山、道明寺一带的战场，抵达平野，已近巳时。

paragraphs.source_en: At the positions in Hirano, each contingent was assigned its own ground to prevent comrades from killing one another, and the challenge was: “Fief or green mountain?”

units.source_en: At the positions in Hirano, each contingent was assigned its own ground to prevent comrades from killing one another, and the challenge was: “Fief or green mountain?”
units.source_zh: 在平野的阵地上，为了防止自相残杀，每支部队负责一个地盘，暗号是：“采邑还是青山？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 在平野的阵地上，为了防止自相残杀，每支部队负责一个地盘，暗号是：“采邑还是青山？”

paragraphs.source_en: Anyone who answered “Fief” was one of their own.

units.source_en: Anyone who answered “Fief” was one of their own.
units.source_zh: 若回答“采邑”，便是自己人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若回答“采邑”，便是自己人。

paragraphs.source_en: Katagiri Katsumoto had come to the front on this occasion, yet boundless sorrow still weighed upon his heart. If Toyotomi Hideyori should take the field in person, Katsumoto would never surrender him into another man's hands.

units.source_en: Katagiri Katsumoto had come to the front on this occasion, yet boundless sorrow still weighed upon his heart.
units.source_zh: 片桐且元此次来到前线，心头依然无限悲哀。

units.source_en: If Toyotomi Hideyori should take the field in person, Katsumoto would never surrender him into another man's hands.

ja.t: するようなことになれば、

units.source_zh: 万一丰臣秀赖亲自出征，且元定不会把他交到别人手里。

paragraphs.source_zh: 片桐且元此次来到前线，心头依然无限悲哀。万一丰臣秀赖亲自出征，且元定不会把他交到别人手里。

paragraphs.source_en: On the left, along the Kishū Highway, the Date forces had formed their lines. Date placed Katakura Kojūrō in the vanguard, with the main force following close behind. Behind the Date stood the Echigo troops of Mizoguchi Nobukatsu and Murakami Yoshiaki, while last came Matsudaira Tadateru's army of nine thousand. Why had Matsudaira Tadateru's force alone been placed at the very rear? That, too, naturally reflected Date Masamune's painstaking consideration.

units.source_en: On the left, along the Kishū Highway, the Date forces had formed their lines.
units.source_zh: 在左边的纪州官道，布下了伊达阵营。

units.source_en: Date placed Katakura Kojūrō in the vanguard, with the main force following close behind.
units.source_zh: 伊达以片仓小十郎为先锋，后面紧跟着主力。

units.source_en: Behind the Date stood the Echigo troops of Mizoguchi Nobukatsu and Murakami Yoshiaki, while last came Matsudaira Tadateru's army of nine thousand.
units.source_zh: 而伊达后方则是沟口宣胜、村上义明的越后军，最后为松平忠辉的九千大军。

units.source_en: Why had Matsudaira Tadateru's force alone been placed at the very rear?
units.source_zh: 为何偏偏将松平忠辉的队伍安排于最后？

units.source_en: That, too, naturally reflected Date Masamune's painstaking consideration.
units.source_zh: 自然也出于伊达政宗的苦心考虑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在左边的纪州官道，布下了伊达阵营。伊达以片仓小十郎为先锋，后面紧跟着主力。而伊达后方则是沟口宣胜、村上义明的越后军，最后为松平忠辉的九千大军。为何偏偏将松平忠辉的队伍安排于最后？自然也出于伊达政宗的苦心考虑。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus the eastern army completed its deployment, and the Hour of the Snake had arrived. Both Ieyasu and Hidetada had reached Hirano, and a ferocious battle was about to begin.

units.source_en: Thus the eastern army completed its deployment, and the Hour of the Snake had arrived.
units.source_zh: 就这样，关东军布阵完毕，已至巳时。

units.source_en: Both Ieyasu and Hidetada had reached Hirano, and a ferocious battle was about to begin.
units.source_zh: 家康和秀忠均已到了平野，一场激烈的战事马上就要开打。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，关东军布阵完毕，已至巳时。家康和秀忠均已到了平野，一场激烈的战事马上就要开打。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu summoned Yoshinao and Yorinobu once more and instructed them in the art of commanding troops in battle. Yorinobu, then holding the title of Lieutenant General of Tōtōmi, had a far fiercer temper than his elder brother Yoshinao and might at any moment dash to the very front and engage the enemy himself.

units.source_en: Ieyasu summoned Yoshinao and Yorinobu once more and instructed them in the art of commanding troops in battle.
units.source_zh: 家康再次叫来义直和赖宣，教给他们领兵作战的心得。

units.source_en: Yorinobu, then holding the title of Lieutenant General of Tōtōmi, had a far fiercer temper than his elder brother Yoshinao and might at any moment dash to the very front and engage the enemy himself.
units.source_zh: 赖宣此时封远江中将，性子比兄长义直烈得多，说不好便会窜到队伍最前头，直接和敌军交手。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康再次叫来义直和赖宣，教给他们领兵作战的心得。赖宣此时封远江中将，性子比兄长义直烈得多，说不好便会窜到队伍最前头，直接和敌军交手。

paragraphs.source_en: “A lieutenant general must not go too far forward. If you advance too far, enemy raiders may strike from the flank and throw your formation into disorder. You must always remain at the very centre of your force. Even on the march, keep your eyes and ears open to everything around you.”

units.source_en: “A lieutenant general must not go too far forward.
units.source_zh: “中将不应太靠前。

units.source_en: If you advance too far, enemy raiders may strike from the flank and throw your formation into disorder. You must always remain at the very centre of your force.
units.source_zh: 太往前，则可能被敌人的游击军从侧面进攻，以致乱了阵脚，应时刻走在队伍最中央。

units.source_en: Even on the march, keep your eyes and ears open to everything around you.”
units.source_zh: 行军时亦当眼观六路，耳听八方。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “中将不应太靠前。太往前，则可能被敌人的游击军从侧面进攻，以致乱了阵脚，应时刻走在队伍最中央。行军时亦当眼观六路，耳听八方。”

paragraphs.source_en: Then Ieyasu gave Yoshinao entirely different advice: “As a councillor, you must watch your retainers carefully in today's battle and discern each man's true nature.”

units.source_en: Then Ieyasu gave Yoshinao entirely different advice: “As a councillor, you must watch your retainers carefully in today's battle and discern each man's true nature.”
units.source_zh: 然后，家康对义直说了一番完全不同的话：“作为参议，在今日的战事中，应仔细观察部下，看清他们的禀性。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 然后，家康对义直说了一番完全不同的话：“作为参议，在今日的战事中，应仔细观察部下，看清他们的禀性。”

paragraphs.source_en: After instructing his two sons and taking his midday meal, Ieyasu led his troops toward Chausuyama at the Tennōji approach. At the time, Ieyasu wore an unlined yellowish-brown robe and rode in a palanquin, while his warhorse was led beside him unridden.

units.source_en: After instructing his two sons and taking his midday meal, Ieyasu led his troops toward Chausuyama at the Tennōji approach.
units.source_zh: 家康教导完两个儿子，用过午饭，便率兵朝天王寺口的茶磨山进兵。

units.source_en: At the time, Ieyasu wore an unlined yellowish-brown robe and rode in a palanquin, while his warhorse was led beside him unridden.
units.source_zh: 是时，家康着一身黄褐色单衣，乘轿，让人牵着战马，未骑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康教导完两个儿子，用过午饭，便率兵朝天王寺口的茶磨山进兵。是时，家康着一身黄褐色单衣，乘轿，让人牵着战马，未骑。

paragraphs.source_en: Beside the palanquin were the messenger Oguri Mataichi Tadamasa, battle-standard magistrate Hosaka Kin'emon, and spear magistrate Ōkubo Hikozaemon Tadataka. Advisers including Nagai Naokatsu, Itakura Shigemasa, Honda Masanobu, and Uemura Iemasa accompanied him on horseback.

units.source_en: Beside the palanquin were the messenger Oguri Mataichi Tadamasa, battle-standard magistrate Hosaka Kin'emon, and spear magistrate Ōkubo Hikozaemon Tadataka.
units.source_zh: 轿旁乃是传令官小栗又一忠政、战旗奉行保坂金右卫门、长枪奉行大久保彦左卫门忠教。

units.source_en: Advisers including Nagai Naokatsu, Itakura Shigemasa, Honda Masanobu, and Uemura Iemasa accompanied him on horseback.
units.source_zh: 永井直胜、板仓重昌、本多正信、植村家政等谋士骑马随行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 轿旁乃是传令官小栗又一忠政、战旗奉行保坂金右卫门、长枪奉行大久保彦左卫门忠教。永井直胜、板仓重昌、本多正信、植村家政等谋士骑马随行。

paragraphs.source_en: Around noon, gunfire sounded ahead. Tadanao's troops, who had surged to the front, began their attack on Sanada Yukimura at Chausuyama. Needless to say, Tadanao's deed was a bid to seize the first honours in defiance of orders.

units.source_en: Around noon, gunfire sounded ahead.
units.source_zh: 中午时分，前面响起了枪声。

units.source_en: Tadanao's troops, who had surged to the front, began their attack on Sanada Yukimura at Chausuyama.
units.source_zh: 冲在最前边的忠直所部开始对茶磨山的真田幸村发动进攻。

Hearing the shots from the right front, Honda Tad朝 was startled and urgently ordered his men forward: “If Echizen steals the honour of the first charge, it will be a disgrace to us, the vanguard. Quickly!”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's rebuke of Tadanao had naturally been meant in part to spur him on, but the medicine had proved too strong. The ferocity of the Echizen assault may be imagined from a folk song handed down by later generations.

units.source_zh: 此时越前部进攻乃是何等激烈，从后世流传的民谣便可以想见。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康对忠直的训斥当然含着激励，但这一剂药过猛了。此时越前部进攻乃是何等激烈，从后世流传的民谣便可以想见。

paragraphs.source_en: Bravely fights the Echizen host, driving the captive foe before it.

units.source_en: Bravely fights the Echizen host, driving the captive foe before it.

The first troops to encounter Mōri Katsunaga's ambush were Honda Tadatomo's spearmen. Tadatomo had rushed into action for fear of falling behind the Echizen troops, and the Echizen men in turn were swept into a savage melee.

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在此时，战场上突然流传起一个奇怪的谣言：“浅野长晟倒戈了！”毋庸置言，流言正是幸村的那些替身散布出来的。

paragraphs.source_en: Amid the fierce fighting, the disparity in numbers was simply too great; nothing could unsettle the eastern army more effectively than a rumour of this kind. The hereditary Tokugawa daimyō would never rebel. But the Asano and Maeda houses had special ties to the Toyotomi, and the direct retainers under Ieyasu and Hidetada had always regarded both families with suspicion. At such a moment, no rumour could have been more perfectly chosen than one claiming that Asano Nagaakira had defected.

paragraphs.source_en: Asano Nagaakira was advancing along the Kishū Highway at the far left of the eastern army, a considerable distance behind even Date Masamune and Matsudaira Tadateru. His men therefore cut across the Date and Matsudaira formations, attempting to proceed directly from Imamiya toward Ikutama and Matsuya.

The force directly connected to his own was the rear of the Echizen army, which continued advancing under the watchful command of his grandson Tadanao.
